experiments.name: Measurement readiness gate
experiments.hypothesis: Every paid click can be tied to signup, 7-day activation and paid subscription by channel and creative.
experiments.actions: Owner: GA4 key events (sign_up, pdf_exported) and Google Ads link; Meta privacy text, SQL, dataset, CAPI token and a test event seen in Events Manager; UTM QA in a private window per ADS.md.
experiments.metric: Test signup appears in GA4 DebugView, Google Ads conversions and Meta Test Events, and in /admin/marketing with the right utm_content.
experiments.decision: No paid test starts until this passes for that channel.

experiments.name: Search demand forecast
experiments.hypothesis: Enough monthly searches exist for tight contractor-estimating keywords to support the SEARCH cap.
experiments.actions: Owner opens Keyword Planner (free in a Google Ads account, no campaign) for 30-50 seed terms per priority trade; export volumes and top-of-page bid ranges.
experiments.metric: Monthly searches and bid ranges per keyword group.
experiments.decision: If forecast CPC exceeds the conservative F01 value, the $300 and $500 scenarios switch to META (rerun the model).

experiments.name: Reach estimates
experiments.hypothesis: Contractor-signal audiences are large enough for the planned spend.
experiments.actions: Owner reads the estimated audience size in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads draft (unpublished) audiences.
experiments.metric: Estimated reach for each draft audience.

experiments.name: Organic landing-page baseline
experiments.hypothesis: Trade landing pages convert organic visitors at a measurable rate before paid traffic arrives.
experiments.actions: Read GA4 landing_view to sign_up by trade page for 30 days.
experiments.sample: At least 300 landing views in total
experiments.decision: If below 2%, fix the landing page before any paid test (paid traffic converts worse than organic).

experiments.name: Lifecycle emails on
experiments.actions: Owner approves LIFECYCLE_EMAIL_MODE; compare matured cohorts before and after.
experiments.sample: All new signups; directional until about 100 per arm
experiments.decision: Keep on unless unsubscribes or complaints spike.

experiments.name: First paid search test
experiments.hypothesis: Contractor-intent keywords produce signups that activate at or above the base assumption.
experiments.actions: One campaign, exact/phrase match on estimate-template and estimating-software terms for the priority trades, strong negatives for homeowner terms; landing on matching /bids/[trade] page. Starts only after X00 passes and the owner approves the ADS.md gate table.
experiments.metric: CTR, CPC, landing conversion, cost per 7-day activated contractor, paid accounts.
experiments.sample: At least 150 clicks before judging landing conversion
experiments.decision: ADS.md stop rules; continue past day 90 only if cost per activated contractor is at or below the base-model value.

experiments.name: Meta creative test
experiments.hypothesis: At least one of concepts B, A or E delivers activated contractors at a lower cost than search.
experiments.actions: One campaign, one ad set, three creatives from ADS.md; optimize on CompleteRegistration only after the CAPI test event is verified.
experiments.metric: Cost per 7-day activated contractor by utm_content.
experiments.sample: About 2,000 impressions per creative before the CTR stop rule applies
experiments.decision: ADS.md stop rules per ad and ad set.

experiments.name: Activation onboarding test
experiments.hypothesis: Opening the builder on the trade picked from the landing page raises 7-day activation.
experiments.actions: Compare activation by entry path (trade chip vs generic) in existing reports; no app change in this phase.

experiments.name: Creator partner pilot
experiments.hypothesis: A trade creator delivers activated contractors at or below search cost.
experiments.actions: Shortlist creators; owner approves outreach and any fee; creator link with utm_medium=creator; FTC disclosure required.
experiments.metric: Clicks, signups, activated and paid by utm_campaign (creator handle).
experiments.decision: Repeat only if cost per activated contractor is at or below search.
experiments.cost_usd: $500-1,000 per deal (assumption; only in the $2,500+ scenarios)

experiments.name: Organic video cadence
experiments.hypothesis: Weekly how-to estimating videos produce search traffic and signups within 90 days.
experiments.actions: Publish per the organic plan; track YouTube Studio search traffic and utm-tagged description links.
experiments.metric: Views from YouTube search, link clicks, signups by utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic.
experiments.decision: Shift organic hours toward the format with the most signups per hour.

experiments.name: Paid conversion read and scale/stop
experiments.hypothesis: Observed funnel is within the model range.
experiments.actions: Pull channel and creative tables from /admin/marketing; compute cost per activated and per paid; rerun build.py with observed values.
experiments.metric: Activated-to-paid rate, CAC, payback by channel.
experiments.sample: Paid conversion is only readable after about 30 activated contractors per channel; below that, report as directional
experiments.decision: Scale only per the ADS.md scale rule; otherwise hold or cut to $0 paid.

experiments.name: Retention first read
experiments.hypothesis: Month-1 and month-2 retention are at or above the base churn assumption.
experiments.actions: Count renewals (subscription_renewed) and cancellations by cohort.
experiments.sample: Needs 6+ months for a real estimate
experiments.decision: Update LTV; no scaling decision on churn under 3 months of data.
